notes.title: Update 1.3.1d
notes.notes:
Small update once again :)

- Volume levels are now fixed and save as they are changed.
- Few minor visual changes. Tiles now have visible borders. (Also thinking about adding new atmosphere for levels like night visuals, purple mist, etc. But I'll still try to keep it to a minimum so no crazy stuff going on in the background)


Thanks for all the support thus far, it means a lot. If you like the game please share it with your friends and play it on your gaming channels (I know many of you are streamers). I'd really appreciate it, leaving reviews also help. ːASMRWolfː

Also, I'm a bit surprised that not much features have been requested, don't be shy, I really want your input to help build a great simulation game. So fire your ideas at me, worst I can say is that it is too large in scope ːsteammockingː 



Thank you and enjoy!

notes.title: Candy Machine release
notes.notes:
Thank you all for showing interest in Candy Machine. I hope you'll have fun and make contributions to the game's Early Access development. Your feedback is the most important factor in the direction the game will go.


I want to make it clear that there are currently 2 modes to play in which can be activated in options. Activating this mode allows more complex recipes as you'll need to take in account heat and moisture. The reason I did this is to get your feedback on which mode plays better as one will have to be the main game mode eventually. So let me know what is best.


Enjoy!


Thanks
